summary: Brag House Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its Merger Agreement with House of Doge Inc. The amendment extends the termination date to June 30, 2026 if the merger has not closed. Under the agreement, Brag House's wholly owned Merger Sub will merge with and into House of Doge, leaving House of Doge as a wholly owned subsidiary of Brag House. No other terms (price, premium, advisors, board recommendation) are disclosed in this amendment. The filing indicates ongoing but delayed deal progress; key watchpoint is whether the merger closes by the new deadline or faces further extension/termination.
